issues.title: Bangladesh Reports Four More Dengue Deaths as 1,181 Patients Hospitalised
issues.title_en: Bangladesh Reports Four More Dengue Deaths as 1,181 Patients Hospitalised
issues.summary: Bangladesh has recorded four more deaths from dengue in the past 24 hours, while 1,181 patients have been admitted to hospitals across the country with the mosquito-borne disease, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS). The figures were released in the DGHS’s regular dengue bulletin on Friday, 16 October, highlighting the continuing pressure […]
